seo.title: Detox camps for internet addicts – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English advanced listening test (CEFR B2). Transcription included. Watch a video about internet addiction and answer the questions.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about South Korean teenagers who are sent to digital detox boot camps. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct option.

See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

choices.html: is the best student in his class
is angry with them for sending him to the detox camp
his phone has never been taken from him before
he hopes he will be able to get online in the camp
he expects to have some kind of entertainment in the camp
has some real friends but they live far away
is growing apart from his real friends

questions.prompt: One of the basic ideas of the boot camp is ...

choices.html: to strengthen their relationship with the real world
to go outdoors more often and not stay at home all day

questions.prompt: After two days in the camp, Kyle ...

choices.html: is happy but he doesn’t think the camp will be a cure
thinks he could be able to live without the internet
believes his addiction is going to improve after this experience
